description: BrowseNet is a novel graph-based RAG framework that performs query-guided traversal over structured Graph-of-Chunks, enabling efficient context retrieval for complex multi-hop queries while achieving state-of-the-art performance with significantly reduced reliance on proprietary LLM inference. [ICLR'26]
